review.why: A lightweight UI audit router with concrete interface checks retrieved from a separate upstream source.
review.summary: Useful for source-level accessibility, focus, forms and interaction review. It downloads its actual rules dynamically, so the SKILL directory fingerprint alone does not bind the reviewed checklist. Not a WCAG certification.
strengths: Concise findings linked to file lines
Covers practical interaction and focus mistakes
cautions: Record or pin the external checklist revision for reproducible reviews
Some brand and style rules are preferences, not accessibility requirements
No license detected for this skill in the extraction
